title: The Smallest Reversible Commitment
short_teaser: When uncertainty is high, the next move can be designed to preserve options.
story: When uncertainty is high, the next move can be designed to preserve options. A limited pilot, short agreement, or test period may create learning without locking in the entire future. Commitment can be scaled to match the quality of the evidence. Strategy is choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Commitment can be scaled to match the quality of the evidence. Strategy is choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change.
spark_application: Identify the decision underneath your current activity. Choose the smallest next move that would create useful information. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
